tasks.label: Build (Web + Windows)
tasks.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build/windows, build/web | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path build/.gdignore)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path build/.gdignore | Out-Null }; Start-Process -FilePath godot -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--import' -NoNewWindow -Wait; Start-Process -FilePath godot -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','Windows','build/windows/Pacmaze.exe' -NoNewWindow -Wait; Start-Process -FilePath godot -ArgumentList '--headless','--path','.','--export-release','"Web"','build/web/index.html' -NoNewWindow -Wait
